title: Vibrant, Creamy German Cheddar Cheese Papillote
description: A rich and vibrant German-inspired dish featuring cheddar cheese, prepared in a delicate papillote. This dish is perfect for special occasions or dinner parties.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the mushrooms and onions, and cook until they are softened and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Slowly pour in the heavy cream, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the cheddar cheese until it is fully melted and the sauce is smooth.
Season with salt, black pepper, and fresh thyme to taste.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Butter a piece of parchment paper and place it on a flat surface.
Spread a thin layer of the cheese sauce on the parchment paper, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Arrange the mushrooms and onions on top of the cheese sauce, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Pour the egg mixture over the mushrooms and onions, making sure to cover the entire surface.
Fold the parchment paper over the filling to form a triangle, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the papillote on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
